title: Opus 5.5 has genuinely gotten so dumb since Fable 5.2 was released
author: zoopesh
selftext: Is it just me or has opus 5.5 gotten super dumb since Fable 5.2 released? It's like the company is forcing us to use their new model by dumbing down the cheaper one. It genuinely kept forgetting things, making stupid decisions based on stupid assumptions instead of asking me first and I don't think that I can use it as an orchestrator anymore.

comments.author: axoncode
comments.body: It feels dumber and way more verbose than at the release.

comments.author: MelodramaticShape
comments.body: Cool what do you want us to do about it

comments.author: Bonelessgummybear
comments.body: I've switched from medium to high effort to compensate. Feels the same, medium effort and low don't follow directions as well

replies.author: JordanRunsForFun
replies.body: The greatest strength of medium is its ability to notice when it should employ a deeper, thinking sub agent.

comments.author: JordanRunsForFun
comments.body: I keep reading this, but I swear it’s just an echo chamber. I have not had, opus make a single notable mistake, running through my full usage on my ultra plan almost entirely using Opus 5.5 high — two game projects and two apps, totaling over a million lines of code and not a single issue… but every time I turn on Reddit, apparently the sky is falling.

comments.body: I agree. I think they nerfed it some. It's still very good, but it was better a week before the fable 5.2 release

comments.body: Opus was always like this. You just had time to find its limitations. Same will happen to fable 5.2. Same happened with astra.

comments.body: Well I use opus 5.5 only since like 2 weeks ago, and I didnt notice any difference, but what u say makes sense.

comments.author: JordanRunsForFun
comments.body: I’m just a normal, solo developer.. who’s been at it for a year, straight daily, through a whole bunch of *nerfed model of the month* hysteria on Reddit. And not once have I had an issue. Not once. I can only conclude that people see these posts and use it doesn’t excuse for declines in their process hiding in their blind spots.
